reference_images: Reference image 1 is the motoboy's character sheet: use it ONLY for his exact face, build, navy reflective-stripe jacket, jeans, sneakers, black insulated backpack and matte-black open-face helmet. Do not reproduce the sheet's panel layout.

Reference image 2 is the capybara's creature sheet: use it ONLY for its exact size, coarse tawny-brown coat, blunt squarish snout and proportions. Do not reproduce the sheet's panel layout or its printed anatomy text.
Reference image 3 is the motorcycle's prop sheet: use it ONLY for its exact Honda CG 150-class look (silver tank, black top-box). Do not reproduce the sheet's panel layout.

Reference image 4 is the environment sheet for this condominium service entrance. Panel 1, CAMERA POV, is exactly what the video camera sees. The other panels are spatial reference only and are never the camera view.
overall_summary: At a Brazilian condominium's service entrance at dusk in light drizzle, a motoboy waits at the guardhouse window while his motorcycle sits parked at the curb. A capybara wanders in from the grass verge and lies down on the one dry patch of pavement under the awning. The motoboy notices, quietly steps aside out of the awning's cover into the drizzle, and puts his helmet on, leaving the capybara the dry spot.
tone: Unplanned real-life condominium security footage: ordinary, observational, imperfect, gently funny because of the motoboy's sincere politeness, never cinematic or commercial.
capture_style: Fixed static condominium perimeter CCTV camera on a lamp-post bracket at the near curb, about 3 m high, facing the guardhouse across the delivery bay, tilted slightly down, wide-angle with mild barrel distortion, 2016 HD IP camera quality (moderate compression, faint noise), no pan, tilt or zoom.
visual_style: Sao Paulo metro suburb, gated condominium service entrance, dusk civil twilight with warm sodium streetlights just on, light drizzle, wet dark asphalt reflecting the lights, a dry lighter-toned paved slab under the guardhouse awning, a grass verge with low shrubs to the right of the slab joined by a flush ramp.
visual_realism: Photorealistic consumer security-camera footage of a real place; the guardhouse, slab, verge, curb and motorcycle stay in one continuous physical layout with realistic scale and contact.
audio_policy: Natural location sound only: light rain/drizzle on the awning and pavement, faint distant city traffic, soft capybara footfalls, the motoboy's quiet exhale and the click of his helmet strap.
camera_lock: Same fixed high-angle CCTV viewpoint, framing, zoom and background in all six frames: same guardhouse, awning, slab, verge, curb and lamp post. No cuts, pans, tilts, zooms or alternate views. Only the motoboy and the capybara move; the motorcycle never moves.
continuity_invariants: Exactly one motoboy and one capybara in every frame; no other people or animals.
The motorcycle is parked upright on its sidestand at the curb in every frame it is visible; it never moves, floats or is ridden.
The capybara is cat-to-small-dog-adjacent in scale, the pale-tan capybara, about 1.2 m long and 0.55 m at the shoulder, never person-sized.
The motoboy's identity matches reference image 1 in every frame; the capybara's identity matches reference image 2.
The dry slab under the awning stays visibly lighter/drier than the wet asphalt beyond the drip line throughout.

panel_convention: Six chronological landscape panels in 3 columns x 2 rows (frames 1-3 top row, 4-6 bottom row), each with a true 16:9 image area and a clean white caption band beneath with only the frame number and caption. No text inside any image area.
hard_constraints: No text or logos inside any image area
